lines: Why does the sweep sleep between batches?

text: So a long sweep never holds the writer for more than one batch. Each batch deletes at most 512 events, then yields for 25 ms so capture can write.

lines: Could we make the batch size configurable?

text: Yes. Add batch_size to RetentionConfig with a default of 512 and clamp it between 64 and 4096. I can draft the change and a test that checks the clamp.
